title: Forget LASIK: Safer, cheaper vision correction without lasers or surgery
summary: Researchers are developing a futuristic alternative to LASIK that reshapes the eye without lasers or incisions. Using mild electrical pulses and platinum contact lenses, they temporarily soften the cornea so it can be molded into a new shape.
